picks.reasoning: GEN have the better players lane for lane, and Chovy alone outclasses anything IG can put in mid. In a best of 1, the more skilled roster wins, so I'm taking GEN.

Gen.G's jungle pathing gets them to first herald and drakes early, and they're up on gold by minute 10. In a Bo1 IG has to win the early skirmishes to stay in it, and against GEN's tempo that's a big ask.

GEN's mid-jungle pool is deeper, and in a best of 1 that lets them draft around whatever IG bans and still get comfort picks. IG needs a cheese draft to win this, and GEN's star carries are on better form.
GEN's season record and their history against LPL sides point their way, but a single game shrinks any edge, so I'm leaning GEN without leaning hard.
GEN plays like a group that trusts each other. They stay calm and stay together under pressure, and in a single game that steadiness usually beats IG's hot streaks.
